title: Iterated regularity and the Poisson obstruction
source_hypothesis: Ordinary properly supported first-order tests with scalar homogeneous principal symbols vanishing on an arbitrary smooth closed conic submanifold. Every finite word has one fixed local B^s_{2,infinity} endpoint. Finite bundles and all real s are included.
component_scope: Wavefront containment, exact scalar-principal commutator powers, homogeneous realization of all conormal first jets, pointwise coisotropy and sharp minimum dimension, with exact ordinary examples.

source_result_coverage.source_result_and_scope: Unnamed ordinary involutivity remark after Lemma 25.1.2: arbitrary submanifold, exact commutator powers and pointwise coisotropy
Minimum dimension, Lagrangian equality and explicit noninvolutive/conormal/ordered-word examples
